title.am: ባሕረ ቀመር — ይትባረክ ገሠሠ መራ · Yitbarek Gessese Merra
title.en: Yitbarek Gessese Merra — Bahre Kemer · ባሕረ ቀመር

description.am: የታሪክ ምሁር፣ ሠዓሊና ደራሲ ይትባረክ ገሠሠ መራ ሥራዎች — ባሕረ ቀመር፣ የኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ትውፊት፣ ቅኔ፣ ግዕዝና ሥዕል።
description.en: The works of Ethiopian historian, painter and author Yitbarek Gessese Merra — the Bahre Kemer number system, the Ethiopian Orthodox tradition, Qene, Ge’ez and painting.

description.am: በዚህ ድረ ገጽ ለቀረቡት ሥራዎች መግቢያና መሠረታዊ ዳራ።
description.en: Introduction and foundational context for the works presented on this site.

heading.en: Introduction, and a Note on What Follows

lede.am: ንቃተ ሕሊና ቀስ በቀስ ከማሠብ ይፈጠራል፡ ይመነጫል፡ ይመሠረታል።
lede.en: Consciousness is born of thinking, little by little: it springs from thought, and is founded upon it.

description.am: በኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ሃይማኖት፣ በግዕዝ፣ በአማርኛ፣ በታሪክና በባህል ላይ የታተሙ ሥራዎች።
description.en: Published works on Ethiopian Orthodox religion, Geez, Amharic, history, and culture.
Original paintings by Yitbarek Gessese Merra.

description.am: በጥንታዊው የግዕዝና የአማርኛ ትውፊት የተቀኙ ቅኔዎች።
description.en: Ethiopian sacred poetry in the classical Geez and Amharic traditions.

description.am: የኢትዮጵያ ቅዱሳት የቁጥር ሥርዓቶች — ትርጉማቸውና መንፈሳዊ ፋይዳቸው።
description.en: The sacred numerical systems of Ethiopia — their meaning and spiritual significance.
Poems of the times — reflections on life and current events.

description.am: የባሕረ ቀመርን ቁጥር ለማንበብ መፍቻ — ሕጎቹ፣ መጻሕፍቱና የጥናቱ ታሪክ።
description.en: A key to reading the Bahre Kemer numbers — the rules behind them, the books, and how the study came about.
Get in touch with the author.
Essays and poems by the author, newest first.
